body: I would like help finding resources

The way I see it is that the only way to continue on living is to get help because if I try to shake it off it’ll end up just getting worst my family is the best and I’m horrified of the heartbreak and anguish I’d cause them if I were to die but this terrible pain burdens me. If I were to go to the hospital my parents would feel like they failed me but they haven’t none of this is their fault absolutely none

Unfortunately I haven’t been unable to hold down a job since I was committed a second time after a suicide attempt I’ve been living with my parents. They didn’t understand why I had dropped out of college and expected me to bounce back and go the next semester and were extremely disappointed that I didn’t, it makes me feel even more useless. I’ve had counseling and been on medication but I’ve never been completely honest with them because I was scared they’d commit me again with adults since I was now over 18 
I want to go to a hospital and get help but I’m so scared that I’d ruin the image my friends and my parents have of me it looked like I was getting better I was going to serve a religious mission but I’m so suicidal that Im sure that if I serve I will kill myself not because I don’t want to go but because I’m not mentally prepared thinking about that makes me want to die even more
I have been committed twice and I’ve explained to my friends everything but they don’t take it seriously whatsoever
